full_judgment: "Unilateral lease document void for offending against provisions of section 107 of TP Actlessor and lessee respectively executed unilateral patta and kabuliyat the same day-The two documents cannot be treated as one for complying with the provisions of section 107-held as each of the documents has not been executed by both the lessor and the lessee, the lease is void."
